name: scalars_sets_and_nulls
query: SELECT date, payee, narration, account, tags, other_accounts, number, TRUE AS t, number > 0 AS positive, NULL AS nothing, cost_number, number / 3 AS third, 'a,b "c"' AS quoted WHERE (account = 'Assets:US:Vanguard:Cash' AND date >= 2017-08-10) OR ('trip-chicago-2016' IN tags AND account ~ '^Expenses' AND date = 2016-11-18) ORDER BY date, number, account
notes: NULL payees and cost numbers, empty and multi-element sets (joined by ',' and quoted), booleans, a 28-digit quotient and a literal that needs quoting
